Yellow rod-like crystals were isolated from the reaction mixture. The main article gives no reagent quantities or complete preparation conditions.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete, neutral Eu28Ti14 macrocyclic wheel with approximately 4.6 nm outer diameter, 2.4 nm inner cavity, and 1.7 nm thickness. Its framework is closely related to that of Eu28Ti14-Bim but has a distinct solid-state packing mode.

properties.summary: Broad visible-region absorption is attributed to ligand-to-metal charge transfer. Compared with the Gd analogue, the Eu wheel has weaker room-temperature photoluminescence and a slightly longer reported carrier lifetime, consistent with reduced radiative recombination. Under illumination it catalyzes CO2 reduction in water coupled to O2 evolution without an added photosensitizer or sacrificial agent.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete Eu28Ti14 wheel approximately 4.6 nm in outer diameter, 2.0 nm across its inner cavity, and 1.7 nm thick. Fourteen [Eu2Ti(μ3-O)] cores form alternating enantiomeric building blocks. Pairs of these blocks constitute seven repeating units linked around the wheel, producing molecular-level sevenfold symmetry and an overall achiral arrangement.
